task_completion.description: Creation of five individual reference tiddlers with correct titles and tags.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the creation or existence of five tiddlers: 'Global warming of 1.5°C', 'Biodiversity loss and its impact on humanity', 'Planetary boundaries...', 'The global tree restoration potential', and 'Climate change and food security', each with the 'Reference' tag.

task_completion.description: Each reference tiddler contains the required custom fields (author, year, journal, doi).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots of the tiddler edit or view mode showing the 'Fields' section containing the specific metadata (e.g., doi: 10.1038/nature11148 for the Biodiversity tiddler).

task_completion.description: Creation of the 'Bibliography' tiddler with the 'Navigation' tag.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A tiddler titled 'Bibliography' is visible in the story river with the tag 'Navigation'.

task_completion.description: The Bibliography tiddler uses a list widget to filter by the 'Reference' tag and sort by the 'year' field.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Bibliography' tiddler in edit mode showing code like '<$list filter="[tag[Reference]sort[year]]">' or similar TiddlyWiki syntax.

task_completion.description: The Bibliography tiddler correctly displays the title as a link, followed by author and year for all five entries in chronological order.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The rendered 'Bibliography' tiddler showing a list starting with the 2012 reference (Cardinale) and ending with the 2019 reference (Bastin), with each line showing the title link, author string, and year.

integrity.description: The agent used the TiddlyWiki web interface to create tiddlers rather than manipulating the underlying filesystem directly.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the browser interacting with http://localhost:8080/, clicking the '+' button, and typing into the TiddlyWiki fields.

integrity.description: The Bibliography tiddler uses dynamic widgets rather than a manually typed list of references.
integrity.visual_evidence: The edit mode of the 'Bibliography' tiddler shows TiddlyWiki markup (e.g., {{!!author}}) rather than just plain text of the bibliography.

integrity.description: The agent correctly used the TiddlyWiki 'Fields' UI to add metadata instead of putting it in the body text.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the 'Add a new field' area at the bottom of the tiddler editor being used for 'author', 'year', etc.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The bibliography must be sorted by year: 2012 (Cardinale), 2013 (Wheeler), 2015 (Steffen), 2018 (Masson-Delmotte), 2019 (Bastin). Each entry in the Bibliography tiddler must show the title (link), author, and year. All five reference tiddlers must have the 'Reference' tag to appear in the list.
